proposal.summary: An insufficient session expiration vulnerability in the ArubaOS CLI allows an attacker to keep a session running on an affected device after the removal of the impacted account.
proposal.cwe_quote: An insufficient session expiration vulnerability exists in the ArubaOS command line interface.

PR.quote: allows an attacker to keep a session running on an affected device after the removal of the impacted account

proposal.recommended_next_step: Validate affected ArubaOS versions, reproduce by creating a CLI session, deleting the account, and confirming session persistence; collect exact conditions (remote/local, required privileges) and prepare coordinated disclosure and patch.
